instruction.name: movcf2fr
instruction.description: Move condition code cj into fd.

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movcf2fr $f0, $fcc0; movcf2fr $f1, $fcc1; movcf2fr $f2, $fcc2; movcf2fr $f3, $fcc3; movcf2fr $f4, $fcc4; movcf2fr $f5, $fcc5; movcf2fr $f6, $fcc6; movcf2fr $f7, $fcc7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4' --asm 'movcf2fr $f0, $fcc0; movcf2fr $f1, $fcc1; movcf2fr $f2, $fcc2; movcf2fr $f3, $fcc3; movcf2fr $f4, $fcc4; movcf2fr $f5, $fcc5; movcf2fr $f6, $fcc6; movcf2fr $f7, $fcc7'
